title: Universal Atlas job lifecycle
issue_presented: What is the single durable lifecycle of a material Atlas job?

known_facts.fact: Task 1 found no universal Atlas job lifecycle; GitHub Actions and Safe Recorder are not that lifecycle.
Task 3 used the local docket as a cabinet because the overlay has no job_id intake.

analysis: COMPLETED must not mean the agent stopped typing. CLOSED requires validation/audit.
judgment_rule: States: PROPOSED → AUTHORIZED → RUNNING → (BLOCKED if needed) → COMPLETED → AUDITED → CLOSED. REJECTED is terminal from PROPOSED/AUTHORIZED.
PROPOSED: job record exists; not permission to change operational systems.
AUTHORIZED: user instruction or recorded Order authorizes the work.
RUNNING: agent is executing authorized work.
BLOCKED: cannot proceed without user confirmation, missing evidence, or a Governance halt.
COMPLETED: declared outputs exist and are referenced; not yet audited.
AUDITED: required validation ran; audit_result recorded.
CLOSED: audit passed or user accepted residual Findings; no USER_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED remains open.
COMPLETED is not CLOSED. Stopping a chat is not COMPLETED.
operational_effect: atlas_gov enforces transitions. Material jobs live under jobs/.
exceptions: Trivial non-material Q&A need not open a job.
supersedes: use of overlay as universal job queue
distinguished_from: docket GOAL papers as the only job record
